'''Cyricept''' was a corporation that operated during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[New Sith Wars]], producing [[Stealth suit/Legends|stealth suits]], such as the [[Cyricept Personal Concealment System, Mark VI]]. The corporation was based in regions controlled by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

As the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]], the enemy of the Republic, expanded their holdings into Republic space, Cyricept repeatedly pulled back their operations from frontier regions without having to be requested to do so by the Republic.
